name: La Vie, la vie
summary: Five friends in their 30s experience romance, success, failures and financial problems while trying to make lives for themselves in Montreal.

name: Mechanical Arms
summary:
Long ago, alien lifeforms came to Earth, fusing with people on the planet. Due to their appearance, they were dubbed "Mecha-ude," as when fused, they bore a striking resemblance to mechanized limbs.

Through an involuntary partnership, average middle schooler Hikaru Amatsuga works alongside the Mecha-ude Arma, who is an extremely rare and special existence. To protect Arma, the resistance group ARMS assigns the dual Mecha-ude user Aki Murasame to follow him wherever he goes. However, she is also looking for a mysterious Snake-Type Mecha-ude wielder, who has put many of her comrades in a critical state.

Behind the scenes, an organization known as the Kagami Group is searching for the mythical "Trigger Arm," a Mecha-ude said to grant unlimited power. When Aki's life is threatened by this group, Hikaru must team up with Arma to find the courage to fight back and, along the way, learn that his life will never be ordinary again.

name: Affair
summary: Siang Pleng and Wan Wanwiwa have grown up in the same household but with different status. Pleng is the child of the homeowner, while Wan works in the house. Although they never want to be separated, one day, Wan tells Pleng that eventually she will have to get married. Pleng plans to find a good man for Wan to avoid her being alone. However, this plan makes Pleng realize her own feelings towards Wan. While their love grows stronger, Pleng loses her parents due to a business failure and escapes, leaving only a love letter for Wan. Later, they encounter again but Wan is engaged.

name: Lady Liberty
summary: Lin Zhanqiao is an independent and emotionally mature woman living in the city. Surrounded by admirers, she has chosen to remain single and live on her own. It's not that she rejects marriage, she simply refuses to settle for anything less than real love and a sincere partnership. Deep down, she has always longed for a genuine romance and a pure, meaningful marriage. When she meets He Dezhang, the two begin with misunderstandings and clashing impressions. But as they grow together through love, career challenges, and life-changing decisions, they gradually realize they are exactly what the other has been searching for. After overcoming the obstacles reality places in their way, they decide to step into marriage together. Meanwhile, Lin Zhanqiao's close female friends each make their own choices in life and eventually find the happiness that suits them best. In the end, they come to understand the true meaning of love and marriage, embracing lives that are simple yet joyful, ordinary yet deeply fulfilling.

name: Riot Island
summary:
Could a prison without bars and armed guards really work? Facing a wave of organized crime in the 1950s, Singapore decided to find out. In a revolutionary new penal initiative, the country sent hardened gangsters to an open-air prison on the idyllic desert island of Pulau Senang. This series explores the pioneering experiment from its inception to its catastrophic end.

Initially lauded worldwide, within three years the prison was making headlines for all the wrong reasons. The whole complex was burned to ashes and the superintendent murdered in one of the worst prison riots in history. In Singapore's trial of the century, 59 men stood accused of rioting and murder. The death sentence hung over these men, but as the trial progressed questions arose about what really happened. Was this prison experiment really as progressive in practice as it was in theory? Was the murdered superintendent an idealistic martyr or a sadistic slave-driver?

Featuring gripping reconstructions, archive footage of the prison and exclusive interviews with former prisoners and the family of the slain superintendent, Riot Island takes the viewer on an immersive journey to discover the truth behind this bloody affair.

name: Cycling: La Vuelta 2024 Highlights
summary: Daily highlights from La Vuelta 2024.

name: Ottoman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
summary: Ottoman Empire by Train follows academic and presenter Professor Alice Roberts in locations ranging from Adana to Konya, Ankara to Istanbul, where she meets local experts to learn about the Ottomans.

name: UEFA Champions League Magazine Show
summary: A review of the latest matches in Europe's premier club competition, plus a look ahead to forthcoming fixtures.

name: Manmaru the Ninja Penguin
summary: An old man named Jiya brings a new recruit, a modest penguin named Manmaru, to join in on a 300-year battle between the three Ninja clans living in the mountains he owns. But the others, the cowardly Tsuenjiro (fox) and quick-tempered Tanutaro (racoon), are disappointed when they learn the newest trainee is nothing other than a polite, if not flaky penguin. And not just any penguin, but a penguin with dreams to become a professional soccer player.

name: Les aventures tumultueuses de Jack Carter
summary: The investigations of Jack Carter, a colorful private detective who only accepts the rare cases that turn him on, those that leave others perplexed.

name: Chica busca chica
summary:
This hot and hilarious lesbian soap opera takes you on a wild ride through the mixed up love lives of a group of sexy Madrid lesbians including the unbelievably gorgeous Spanish TV star Celia Freijeiro. 
Think: The L Word meets Almodovar.

name: Live in Love
summary: An innocent compliment during a livestream brings Kla, who doesn't have a sweet tooth, and the innocent Cake together. It isn't long until their interactions begin to spread like wildfire on social media, sparking heated discussions. A story full of love and warmth begins!

name: TRIO: Odins Gull
summary: Despite the fact that countless treasure hunters have disappeared whilst attempting to track down the so-called Odin's Gold, the three friends Nora, Lars and Simen set out on a thrilling adventure around the mountain village of Skjåk.

name: Dring
summary: Ringing an unknown doorbell has its share of surprises, risks, and adventures. This is the daily life of our six heroes. Six tireless sales reps who, all day long, reel off their spiel from landing to landing. Although their pitch is well-rehearsed, nothing ever goes as planned. The inhabitants of this very strange building lead them from absurd situation to absurd situation. Dring's troupe thus takes us into a Kafkaesque world where these salespeople discover to their cost that selling is truly a combat sport.

name: Room
summary: A group of men with their own reasons come to a resort hotel. A novelist struggling to meet a manuscript deadline, a popular actor on a secret trip with his girlfriend, a salaryman who wants to quit his job to deal with complaints, and a kidnapper who is holding a hostage in a room. When these complete strangers meet, a miracle happens...!?

name: San Francisco International Airport
summary: Jim Conrad serves as the manager of the bustling San Francisco airport, where issues emerge on a daily basis. Bob Hatten holds the position of troubleshooting maintenance chief, while June is his reliable and efficient secretary.

name: Glaskupan
summary: When her friend's daughter goes missing, forensic psychologist Lejla must confront the haunting trauma of her own childhood abduction.

name: The Garms Dealer
summary: Sam Morgan and Channel 4.0 present The Garms Dealer, who takes us through some of the rarest items on the planet.

previousepisode.name: Emile Smith Rowe Wants ULTRA RARE Sneakers

name: Lost Treasures of Angkor: Ancient Laos Revealed
summary: A team of archaeologists investigate one of the greatest treasures ever found.

name: The Weekly Football Wrap
summary: Join Claudio Fabiano and the team every Monday night for the latest news, expert opinion and the best action from the World of Football.

name: Titanic Sinks Tonight
summary:
Titanic Sinks Tonight aims to provide a complete picture of the most famous 160 minutes in maritime history, telling the astonishing story of the sinking of the Titanic in real time. From the crucial seconds just before the ship hits the iceberg, to the moment the hull sinks beneath the waves, this series pieces together the events, minute by minute, to reveal exactly what happened to the 2240 passengers and crew on 14 and 15 April, 1912.

Combing through a vast archive of eyewitness testimony, the series relives the sinking through the experiences of those who were there, unpacking the anatomy of the disaster and identifying the critical decisions that dictated the fate of those on board. Nothing is invented, there are no ‘composite characters', just the real words of the actual Titanic passengers and crew.

name: Boybands Forever
summary: Boybands Forever will dive into pop culture in the 90s and 00s, telling the tales behind the success of some of the UK and Ireland's most celebrated popstars, who were idolised by millions of pop fans around the world.

name: Scandal
summary: Ha Eun Joong, a detective at Gangnam Police station. He became a detective to try to understand his dad better, who was an ex-detective. However, he discovers that his father, Myung Geun, actually kidnapped him when he was a child. Myung Geun had lost his own son in a building collapse, and as revenge against the man responsible, Jang Tae Ha, he abducted Tae Ha's son and raised him as his own. In the aftermath of revenge, Eun Joong searches for the truth and becomes caught between his two fathers and the woman he loves, Woo Ah Mi.

name: De Ring
summary: How far will you go to hide a mistake? How much is your career worth to you? Lawyer Anna is faced with an impossible choice. Will she allow herself to be sexually blackmailed to mask her misstep, made in a moment of recklessness?

name: Laura H.
summary: The true story of Laura, the teenager from Zoetermeer who chose to travel to the caliphate in Syria with her husband and two children. When she shows up at the border in 2016 and says she escaped and regrets it, doubts about her motives are great.

name: Angry Young Men: The Salim Javed Story
summary: Salim-Javed, the legendary screenwriters of 70's Hindi cinema co-wrote 24 films in 11 years, of which 20 were blockbusters. They created the Angry Young Man the brooding anti-hero who captured the imagination of an entire nation. Like the character, Salim Khan & Javed Akhtar, two outsiders, defied all odds and rose to superstardom. Hindi cinema never saw a cultural collaboration as powerful again.

name: The Floor Sverige
summary: The Floor is a grand family entertainment program where 100 competitive Swedes meet in duels on a giant LED floor divided into a hundred equally sized squares, each of which represents a person and an area of knowledge.

name: Power Couple
summary: Seven famous couples stay together in one of the most luxurious villas in the Netherlands. Led by Monica Geuze and Valerio Zeno, they compete with each other, with the ultimate weapon: love! Through exciting and extremely confrontational challenges, they rediscover their own relationship and the relationships of the other couples. Which couple knows each other best? Which couple is the most attuned to each other and can work together the best? Who will be crowned Power Couple 2024?

name: Чужие деньги
summary:
The brilliant cash-out Alexey Voronov goes on the run. Fearing persecution, he decides to plant a "drop" in his place, Yura Afanasyev, a provincial loser who is the spitting image of Voronov himself. However, the perfect plan gets out of control: Voronov gets a bullet in the head, and Afanasyev is saved by Alexey's security, who mistake him for their boss.

In a spacious apartment, at meetings, in bed with his girlfriend Alina – now Afanasyev will have to take someone else's place, become a different person and master the skills of a brilliant swindler from scratch, escape from the sights of criminal structures, corrupt officials and security forces. And finally get the luxurious life he always dreamed of.

previousepisode.name: De resultaten van het stressexperiment zijn bekend

name: Hitochigai Kara Hajimaru Koi Mo Aru
summary:
The story follows Kai (played by Takuma Usa), a kind-hearted but clumsy man who struggles to get anything right. Burdened with debt, he is kicked out of his home one day. He receives a call from his twin brother Riku, who is abroad on a business trip. Riku offers him a deal: "You can stay at my place, and I'll even pay off all your debts. But in return…"

When Kai enters his brother's house, a mysterious man named Chiaki (played by Ryutaro Imai) suddenly barges in, hugs him, and kisses him. It turns out that Chiaki is Riku's lover. Riku then asks Kai to pretend to be him and break up with Chiaki to pay off his debts. Thus begins a tumultuous mistaken identity room-share story.

name: Los Reyes de Oriente
summary: A tight-knit crew of three reigns over a bustling barrio in Mexico City — until a sudden tragedy breaks their crowns and renders two of them rivals.

name: Evolution of the Black Quarterback
summary: Evolution of the Black Quarterback follows retired NFL Pro Bowl quarterback Michael Vick as he travels across America to explore the history and impact of Black quarterbacks on and off the field. The series pays homage to the rich history, celebrates the progress, and sets its sights on the future of the QB position.

name: The Long Way Back
summary: Commissioned by the National Radio and Television Administration to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, this series is penned by acclaimed screenwriters Gao Mantang, Li Li, Ru Sheng, and Li Zhou, with directors Zang Xichuan and Zhao Yang at the helm. Through the lens of ordinary resistance fighters' growth, it reflects the 14-year nationwide struggle following the "September 18 Incident," highlighting the most arduous chapter of the Communist Party-led Northeast Anti-Japanese United Forces and the people's relentless fight against Japanese imperialist invasion.

name: Hidden Love
summary: Li Chuchu, an illegitimate daughter of the Duke's Mansion, has lived under the harsh suppression of the official wife for over a decade. When fate suddenly turns against her, she unexpectedly discovers that there is a mastermind behind her birth mother's death. She then sets out on a path of vengeance. In the process, she becomes entangled in a web of love, hatred, and obsession with her legitimate half-brother Li Zhen. Bound by restrained affection and deep emotional tension, the two search for truth and justice together…

name: Fate's Crossing Nan & Ke
summary: In the mysterious Forgotten River Inn, fate weaves a tangled love story between the cold-faced constable, Shen Nan, and the enigmatic woman, A Ke. With her unique ability to enter the dreams of the living, A Ke uncovers the secrets of the past, only to realize that her destiny is intertwined with Shen Nan's, bound by a love that transcends lifetimes.

name: Dawn Amidst Hidden Clouds
summary: Lan Che, a street girl dedicated to protecting her neighborhood, unexpectedly gets caught up in a murder case and crosses paths with Lou Mingye, the head officer of the Dali Temple. Initially, their vastly different personalities lead to frequent misunderstandings, but as they get to know each other better, they clear up their differences and work together to solve a series of mysterious cases. Throughout this journey, their bond deepens, and they come to recognize each other's true identities, eventually they both falling in love.

name: Актёрище
summary: Vyacheslav Tretyakov is a superstar of modern Russian cinema. The perfect picture is spoiled only by the devastating reviews of the blogger-film critic Nikita Kislyak. Tretyakov tries to force Kislyak to delete the video and breaks into a public fight. To restore her reputation and avoid trial, the star will have to fulfill the condition of the hated film critic — forgetting about pride and large contracts, play the main role in an unknown provincial theater.

name: Prague with Michael Portillo
summary: Michael explores the capital of the Czech Republic.

previousepisode.name: What Passes for Love in East Pittsburgh

name: Cadets
summary: Set in 1998 before the historic Kargil war, four boys set foot in the prestigious Armed Forces Academy. Cadets is a coming-of-age story about a world where boys become men of honour.

name: Real High School Romance
summary: Graduated students who become adults go on a trip together to find love.

name: Alter Ego
summary: In the aftermath of Fat Thursday, the body of a girl is found near Bellinzona. The team of officers engaged in the investigation will find themselves investigating crimes rooted in a past full of shadows. Under scrutiny will be not only the crimes that bloodstain the town, but also and above all the human soul, that of a community that believes it has nothing to hide.

name: Born for the Spotlight
summary: From leading ladies to rising ingenues, women under the limelight must juggle friendship and ambition in their tenacious pursuit of art and stardom.

name: En Fin
summary: On the day the apocalypse was supposed to happen, Tomás wakes up hungover in the middle of an orgy in a furniture store. Months earlier, he had left his wife Julia and daughter Noa with the news that the world was ending, without looking back. But when the wandering planet that was going to crash the world passes Earth and life goes on, Tomás realizes the extent of his mistake. Now he will try to regain his former life and the forgiveness of his family, trying to rebuild a world that has not ended, but will never be the same. Meanwhile, Julia, who has always taken things slowly, sees this as a second chance and takes a leap to do all the things she didn't dare to do before. Noa, on the other hand, wonders why the adults insist on destroying the world all by themselves, without the need of a giant planet crashing into the Earth.

name: Su Majestad
summary: Spain, year 2024. Pilar is a young Princess and future Queen of Spain who, suddenly and hastily, is forced to lead the institution after a scandal involving her father King Alfonso XIV takes him out of the public eye for a few months. Pilar must prove to the country that she is not the irresponsible, insolent, lazy and useless woman that everyone believes her to be. The thing is, they might be right.

name: Cochinas
summary: Valladolid, 1998. Nines is a conservative-minded housewife who is forced to confront everything she thought she knew about herself when her husband falls into a coma, leaving the family video store in her hands. Nines discovers that the business is bankrupt, and she decides to specialize in the only genre that makes them money: porn. Just what she needed, to be surrounded by penises and nipples all day long. It's a good thing she has the help of Chon, the foul-mouthed video store employee, and Agu, a die-hard film buff, to turn "Dorothy" into the city's first adult video store, a place that will end up becoming the epicenter of an earthquake among the neighborhood's residents. Sexual liberation is now unstoppable.

name: Dime tu nombre
summary: Spain, 1997. The inhabitants of Río Blanco, a strawberry-growing village, have accepted that the Moroccan seasonal workers settle in Fuensanta, an abandoned village. But the coexistence generates tensions. Sonia, head of an NGO that helps with integration, knows this. So does Father Ángel, the local priest. And even Safir, the imam. But what none of them imagine is that Fuensanta's foundations hide something capable of unleashing their worst nightmares. The most ancient pain. The most ancestral fear. Regardless of your beliefs... or who you pray to.

name: The Zelensky Story
summary: Comedian, actor, president, war leader - in his own words. The extraordinary life of one of the world's most recognisable leaders, and how war in Ukraine changed everything.

name: OT23: La gira
summary: The documentary, produced by Gestmusic (Banijay Iberia), will consist of two episodes. The first, 60 minutes long, will explore the changes in the contestants' lives after their time at the Operación Triunfo Academy and follow the rehearsals for this summer's music tour. It will give viewers a unique insight into the emotions behind the scenes during the concerts and the celebrations at each successful tour stop, which has already sold over 150,000 tickets. The second episode will be a special film of the concert, filmed at the WiZink Centre, allowing viewers at home to enjoy the unforgettable experience of this tour.

name: Family By Choice
summary: Yoon Ju-won is a bright, down-to-earth girl who lives with her single father, Yoon Jeong-jae, when Kim San-ha and Kang Hae-jun, two boys from complicated circumstances, come into her life. Her father takes in the boys to grow up together as a family. Despite being unrelated by blood, Ju-won adores San-ha and Hae-jun and thinks of them as her brothers, no matter how differently others think or say. They reunite after a decade apart - facing new dynamics, unresolved pain and the complexities of adulthood.

name: Medina: El estafador de famosos
summary: "Medina" is a mysterious character who has spent the last 20 years scamming dozens of TV personalities by pretending to be a former colleague with a personal drama. No one has managed to find him yet, but Jorge Ponce sets out to try with this documentary. Is a comedian the right person to hunt down Spain's biggest celebrity swindler, or is there more than one imposter in this series?

name: El Circo de los Muchachos
summary: The docuseries taps into the incredible story of Father Jesús Silva, known as "el Cura," who created a city and educational project for street children without resources in Benposta, a small neighborhood in the suburbs of Ourense (Galicia) during Franco's dictatorship in Spain in 1956. Silva created a nation of boys, with its own currency and passport, governed by children under the approval of the Francoist government and church. Over time, Benposta became a town steeped in art, education, and enthusiasm, and Silva founded "El Circo de los Muchachos," a fascinating show that took these children without resources around the world impressing audiences with their circus skills, ending up performing at New York's Madison Square Garden.

name: Infiltrada en el búnker
summary: This is the story of an undercover investigator who sacrificed everything and risked her life to show the world the harsh reality she experienced over two years inside an animal testing laboratory. Her investigation, which she eventually named 'The Bunker', is captured in hundreds of hours of hidden camera footage that reveals serious cases of animal abuse. Infiltrated in the Bunker is a thriller that exposes the longest infiltration inside a pharmaceutical laboratory in the world, nd puts into perspective while shedding light on an inescapable social debate: the use of animals in scientific experimentation.

name: The Pasta Queen
summary: The Pasta Queen features Nadia Caterina Munno, descendant of an Italian pasta dynasty, who has racked up millions of followers on TikTok and Instagram. Each episode, audiences will travel through Italy with Nadia, then spend time in her chef's kitchen as she shares essential ingredients from the Italian regions she visited, and makes authentic Italian dishes with love.

name: The Antiques Brothers
summary: Antique dealer brothers Henry and Edward set sail down France's most beautiful rivers on the hunt for French treasures to take home and auction off.

name: Tom Kerridge Secrets of the Pub Kitchen
summary: Tom Kerridge picks popular items on the menus at modern British pubs and gives them his own twist. He takes inspiration from modern gastropubs to create simple, contemporary, and delicious recipes.

name: O Som e a Sílaba
summary: Sarah is a young autistic woman with an extraordinary ability for lyrical singing. She begins taking lessons with renowned soprano Leonor Delise, but there is tension in the relationship. Sarah will learn to turn her silences into emotions; Leonor will have to restore her faith in humanity and reconcile with her daughter. Music will be the bond that transforms their lives.

name: Shrink
summary: Shrink is a human drama that reaches straight to the hearts of those who are suffering because they cannot resolve their mental troubles, and those who are worried about their family and friends who are facing such anguish.

name: Social Studies
summary: Filmed in Los Angeles over a school year, this groundbreaking social experiment features a diverse group of LA teens who open up their lives and phones to offer an intimate glimpse into how social media has reshaped childhood.

name: I Left My A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
summary: As far as adventuring goes, supporting your party is a thankless job—even more so if you're just a lowly red mage like Yuke Feldio. So, when he gets fed up with his A-rank party of total a-holes, he ditches them for some former students—a trio of girls who just looove his company. Thing is, to conquer the world's greatest dungeon and achieve his dream, he'll have to teach these cuties a thing or two…and he may just learn there's more potential within him (and them) then he ever knew.

name: CBS Mornings Plus
summary:
CBS News will launch a live third hour of CBS Mornings on television and streaming named CBS Mornings Plus, which will debut Monday, Sept. 30 with Tony Dokoupil and Adriana Diaz as co-hosts. CBS MORNINGS PLUS (9:00-10:00 AM, ET) will air weekdays on CBS-owned stations in Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Detroit and Miami and simulcast on CBS News 24/7, CBS News' national, free streaming news network.

CBS Mornings Plus will be produced by the award-winning CBS Mornings team and take viewers deeper into the most important headlines of the day, as well as pop culture, entertainment, health, wellness and financial news. Dokoupil, who will continue as co-host of CBS MORNINGS, and Diaz, will drive in-depth interviews and original reporting on major news stories each day during the new live hour.

previousepisode.name: Dr. Shelby Harris, Kenneth C. Davis

name: On va dire les termes
summary: And what if changes to language could bring wider changes to our society? With her acute sense of detail, Athéna Sol invites us to explore the new words shaping a contemporary and more inclusive francophone world.

name: Pigs Next Door
summary: Pigs Next Door is a 2000 Irish-German television series produced by Magma European Scripting House and EM.TV. The series is the first to come out of a three-year deal signed in late 1998 between EM.TV and Magma to develop two animated series per year. It was picked up by Fox TV in the United States[1], but it never aired prime-time on Fox Family Channel as planned.[2]

name: Descent
summary: Convinced they can find a new home for humanity and save the world from climate doom, three 'scientists' descend to the bottom of the ocean...to Eel City.

name: Birth of a Conflict
summary: The Mandate is a 3 part documentary that will shed new and surprising light on one of most forgotten period in Israel's history - The British Mandate. The 30 years of British rule in Palestine, where in fact, the most decisive in forming the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the modern Middle-East. The series encounter Jewish, Arab and British scholars, who try, for the first time, understanding and agreeing on the answer to the question - How and why started the 100 years old conflict between Jews and Arabs? The historical narrative is brought through secret documents that were only recently revealed. Rare archive footage from the early 20th century and by using a treasure found, in the shape of hundreds of hours of footage from the 1980's series "Pillar of Fire" that include personal interviews with the people who were personally involved in the historical events of the Mandate.

name: Radio 2 In the Park
summary: Stand by for the ultimate classic pop and rock line up! Find out all the different ways you can enjoy Radio 2 in the Park.

previousepisode.name: Best of Radio 2 in the Park 2026

name: Viaplay Premier Sunday
summary: Peter Schmeichel, Freddie Ljungberg and Jaap Stam, three of the Premier League's greatest-ever players, will lead Viaplay Premier Sunday, a new and exclusive live studio format available on Viaplay in six countries. Hosted by UK sports presenter Jules Breach, this superstar line-up will be pitchside for 10 of the biggest matches during the 2024/2025 Premier League season. Fans can look forward to unique perspectives on the latest action from the world's most popular football league, along with views and reactions straight from the top players and managers.

name: Chef's Table: Noodles
summary: Viewers will embark on a delicious journey across the globe, exploring the rich and diverse world of noodles through the eyes of four masterful chefs. This season celebrates the cultural significance and culinary artistry of noodles, offering a deep dive into both traditional and innovative techniques.

name: Chef's Table: Legends
summary: The Emmy-nominated series celebrates four culinary giants — Jamie Oliver, José Andrés, Alice Waters and Thomas Keller — who changed how the world eats.

name: Out There: Crimes of the Paranormal
summary: Out There: Crimes of the Paranormal takes you inside eight true crime cases with shocking encounters with the paranormal world - through eyewitness accounts, expert interviews, and all-new investigations. In each case, amidst an agonizing search for answers, one rumor emerges from the pack: something inhuman is afoot. These in-depth investigations transport us to towns and cities across North America where we speak to individuals with eyewitness accounts and first-person details about the extraordinary, supernatural events that changed their lives forever. A six-year-old boy in the Smoky Mountains disappears forever after being snatched by a mysterious ape-like beast. A UFO crash in Long Island sparks an assassination attempt and illuminates a massive political conspiracy. An occult coven of Satanic witches is implicated in a decades-old New Jersey murder. Lonely ghosts in San Francisco's Chinatown threaten to steal the lives of the unmarried. In these stories and more, "Out There" tracks down fresh leads and uncovers new evidence amid a labyrinth of twists and turns. At the end of the road, the investigations unearth new truths – about the power of mythology, the allure of the paranormal, and the monsters among us.

name: Celebrations with Lacey Chabert
summary: Celebrations with Lacey Chabert will follow the beloved Hallmark Channel star, designer and philanthropist as she surprises deserving kids, families and adults who are making a positive impact in their communities by throwing them the celebration of a lifetime.

name: Coming For You
summary: After a successful auction, renowned auctioneer Qi Xuan accidentally damages an ancient painting and faints after touching it. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the unfamiliar Jing Dynasty as Su Wangfei, the wife of War God Duke Su Qianyu. To her surprise, just as she finds a way back to her time, she and her husband swap bodies, complicating her situation even further.

name: Be Your Knight
summary: Xiang Tingdong, heir to the renowned Tangcheng family, is severely injured in a dispute with his fiancée Cheng Che and falls into a coma. To save the Xiang family, Cheng Che finds Xiang's mysterious younger brother, Ye Ran, and asks him to impersonate Xiang. Together, they uncover and dismantle the drug syndicate Xiang Tingdong was involved with. Will they succeed in completing their mission?

name: Anthropozän - Das Zeitalter des Menschen
summary: Within a relatively short period of time, an evolutionarily very young species has conquered planet Earth and fundamentally changed it. Investigates how much man has already shaped his home planet - consciously or unconsciously - and what this means for all the other animals and plants on earth. Can negative trends still be stopped or is the "Anthropocene" the end?

name: Widow's Bay
summary: Widow's Bay is about a mysteriously cursed New England island and its superstitious citizens, led by a mayor who refuses to believe their warnings.

previousepisode.name: We Hope You Enjoyed Your Time!

name: World's Most Notorious Killers
summary: Peacock's new true crime docuseries World's Most Notorious Killers follows the chilling stories of five shocking international murder investigations of recent times. Each episode will re-examine a different case from some of the most infamous criminals across the globe, and will feature firsthand accounts from former detectives, family members, lawyers, forensic scientists and journalists all dedicated to bringing these murders to justice.

name: Nelly Knows Mysteries
summary: When advice columnist Nelly finds her childhood friend Dahlia's boyfriend dead, she joins detective Hogan to help find the killer. However, as suspicions creep in, Dahlia becomes a prime suspect.

name: Jazz Ramsey: A K-9 Mystery
summary: When Jazz Ramsey and her crime detection dog Zeus stumble upon an old crime scene, the K9 trainer, her star pup, and ex-boyfriend and lead detective Nick are thrown into the investigation.

name: Let's Go Pocoyo
summary: Let's Go Pocoyo! is a Spanish children's television show, a spin-off of Pocoyo. The show is aimed for preschoolers. It debuted in 2009 and airs in The Gaeilge on TG4.

name: Güzel Aşklar Diyarı
summary: With Deniz's surprise arrival to the Alaca Family, one of the most deep-rooted families in Cappadocia, the balances within the family will change completely.

name: Ten House
summary: At the iconic FDNY Ten House, two rookies grapple with their legacies as children of 9/11 first responders while navigating burgeoning feelings toward one another, the firehouse's well-trained yet formidable veterans, and the demands of emergency response in the ever-changing yet always challenging city of New York.

name: East of Eden
summary: East of Eden will explore the novel's themes of trauma and repair; love and betrayal; duty and free will. The series will sketch an intimate portrait of the Trask family against the backdrop of huge historical forces.

name: 30 Tage Lust
summary: 30 Tage Lust follows high school sweethearts Freddy and Zeno, both about to turn thirty. A daring experiment puts a long-term relationship to the test: Freddy and Zeno agree to 30 days of sex with whomever they want. Throughout the experiment, awkward dates and bizarre encounters create suspicion between them, while moments of tenderness emerge amidst the emotional rollercoaster. As day 30 + 1 approaches, the question remains: Has the experiment brought them closer, or has it been too much to ask? The melancomedy offers a highly relatable exploration of navigating life when you're almost thirty and the journey of self-discovery still proves elusive.

name: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen USA
summary: Paula McIntyre travels to the United States on a food adventure, to look at the influence of the Ulster-Scots on America's table. Over time, they became known as the Scots-Irish and their foodways and the ingredients they brought with them have become an integral part of American cuisine.

name: Paid in Full: The Battle for Black Music
summary:
Paid In Full: The Battle for Black Music explores the systemic racism faced by Black artists in the music industry from its inception to the digital streaming age.

Despite remarkable success stories, prejudicial practices persist in the machinery of the music industry, with exploitative contracts and copyright arrangements often hindering artists' autonomy and financial reward and coming with a devastating personal cost.

Paid In Full: The Battle for Black Music documents the extent of the historic injustice suffered by the music industry's Black artists, including the disparity of profits received by them, despite having created the records that have driven the fabric and culture of popular music - from jazz and rock and roll to soul and rap.

name: Leo og de farlige
summary: Leo Ajkic meets some of those serving an indefinite prison term. Those who are not released back into society until they have changed. But can they be changed?

name: Mania de Você
summary: In the paradisical setting of Angra dos Reis, two women have their destinies intertwined in a game of love, power and obsession, which changes the trajectory of their lives forever.

name: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
summary: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey explores the tragic unsolved murder of six-year-old beauty queen JonBenét Ramsey. It follows the Ramsey family, before and after the tragedy as they go through the painful loss of a child while facing intense public scrutiny caused by a media frenzy that caused this case to captivate an entire nation. At the heart of the series, it is the story of Patsy and John Ramsey – exploring the unbreakable partnership of these two complex people – as husband and wife, as mother and father – who had committed themselves and their children to building the narrative of a perfect, privileged life only to have it destroyed one Christmas night in 1996.

name: The ‘Burbs
summary: Set in present-day suburbia, The ‘Burbs follows a young couple returning to the husband's childhood home. Their world is upended when new neighbors move in next door, bringing old secrets of the cul-de-sac to light, and new deadly threats shatter the illusion of their quiet little neighborhood.

name: Iniúchadh TG4
summary: A current affairs series in which Kevin Magee breaks stories and investigates the issues behind the headlines. Iniúchadh TG4 will feature political stories, social issues and analysis from all over Ireland.

name: The Jane Mysteries
summary: Singer Jane DaSilva inherits the family foundation which is a non-profit detective agency that helps people who aren't able to help themselves. Jane's Aunt Sadie and Detective John Cameron act as her mentors as she takes on her first case surrounding a mother's untimely death years before. As Jane investigates a multi-level marketing company that took advantage of her client's fragile mom, she realizes that digging up the past can be dangerous...

name: Rachael Ray's Italian Dream Home
summary: Rachael Ray's dream since childhood has been to own a villa in Tuscany. Now that dream is about to become a reality … well, hopefully.

name: Love on the Danube
summary: The new trilogy Love On the Danube promises romance, a picturesque cruise down the Danube River and Strauss waltzes among beautiful sights and sounds.

name: The Tithes
summary: The Tithes is a three-part Warhammer animation anthology. It's composed of three self-contained stories that each shine a different light on an interesting and little-explored slice of this vast, dystopian setting: The Imperial Tithe.

name: May Your Misery Exceed Mine
summary: Keiko Natori is a housewife in her first year of marriage. Her husband is Shinichi Natori, who is elite and kind. She has her best friend Yuka and her younger sister Shiho Aihara. They all wish for Keiko Natori's happiness. Keiko Natori enjoys her happy life until Keiko Natori begins to suspect that her husband is having an affair. At first, she suspects her best friend Yuka is the one who is having the affair with her husband. She then suspects someone else close to her.

name: Cui Can Xing Tu
summary: After being betrayed by An Sheng, Su Lu Xia gets a second chance to start over. With the help of the system, Su Lu Xia changes her destiny by resolving the scandal that An Sheng sets her up with and finds a footing in the entertainment industry alongside her new male lead, Gu Chen.

name: Elisabeth Rioux: Sans filtres
summary: A window into the exciting world of social media sensation and entrepreneur, Elisabeth Rioux, as she leads the international expansion of Hoaka Swimwear while juggling romance, family and motherhood. This is Elisabeth Rioux unfiltered.

name: The Prisoner of Zenda
summary: Adaptation of Anthony Hope's novel in six parts, by James Andrew Hall. The Prisoner of Zenda is the great swashbuckling story of the English gentleman Rudolf Rassendyll and his adventures in Ruritania.

name: Murder Club
summary: Amélia Delcourt, 32, is an intrepid police officer, recently integrated into the Crime Department, and fed up with news stories from her mother Babeth, an absolute fan of true crimes. Too eager to prove herself and trusting her instincts as always, she makes a terrible mistake during an operation, ruining months of work trying to uncover Shakespeare, a serial killer who is spreading terror in the north of France.

name: Tea Town Teddy Bears
summary: Ginger, Earl Grey and Boba are three tea-party-loving Teddy Bears who have adventures with their friends in Tea Town. Ginger creates fashions and invitations, Earl Grey does the baking and tea-making and Boba makes things beautiful. With their flying teacup that transforms into a tea party table, they have tea parties in all kinds of places like the tops of trees, on the upstairs porch at Grandma's teapot and even in the clouds.

name: Glitter and Greed: The Lisa Frank Story
summary: A four-part documentary event that penetrates the neon-hued world of Lisa Frank Inc., a brand that defined girlhood for a generation of Americans only to seemingly disappear overnight. Behind the rainbows and psychedelic illustrations, we unravel a nostalgia-soaked, stranger-than-fiction tale that takes us into the hidden world that has been lurking at the heart of the company for decades.

name: Killer Cakes
summary: From horror visionaries Blumhouse Television, and Cake Boss creators High Noon Entertainment, Killer Cakes is a one-of-a-kind competition show where bakers with terrifying skills attempt to win some of the most frightening challenges ever produced for television. Contestants will work with the best horror special effects artists in Hollywood to unleash their twisted imaginations and create cakes so disgusting, so disturbing, and so realistic, it's the stuff of nightmares.

name: Klass 95: el poder de la belleza
summary: Shaio Domínguez, in the 1990s in Colombia, founded the first international modeling agency, through which she discovered the power of beauty. Edgar Trejos, a frontman for mobsters, sees in Shaio and her agency the opportunity to clean up his image and will do everything possible to infiltrate them. An impossible love, beautiful women, many dreams to fulfill, and a situation that spirals out of control.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Berny regresa a Colombia y se encuentra con Shaio, ¿terminan juntos?

name: Xiangbei Regret
summary: Freelance photographer Mo Xiangbei unexpectedly gets pregnant while her childhood boyfriend, Mu Yinan, is focused on his career. As tensions rise over his frequent absences and an actress's advances, Mo becomes increasingly suspicious. After the loss of her mother and miscarriage, she breaks down and leaves Mu, starting a new life in Dali with a small shop called "Regret Inn," seeking self-redemption.

name: Fate of Beauty
summary: It tells the story of the female lead, Xia Anle'er, whose family was falsely accused by her fiancé, Xiao Yeting, during her youth, leading to their devastating downfall. After years of preparation to restore her family's honor, she must endure humiliation and disguise herself to approach her enemy. In the process of searching for evidence, she caught the attention of Xiao Muran. The love-hate entanglement among the three resolved through love, and ultimately, they protected each other. Together, they not only cleared their grievances but also let go of hatred, rediscovered themselves, and pursued true love.

name: Junior Eurovision
summary:
Junior Eurovision is BACK and this year we have changed things up completely!


This year, we're on the road, following the action around the country as hundreds of hopefuls apply for our national auditions in recent weeks where they hope to win the hearts of our judges and be in with a chance to sing in the biggest music competition for young people in the world!

From these hundreds of musicians, ten will be chosen to come to the studio and compete for the big prize - the chance to sing for Ireland in the JUNIOR EUROVISION SONG CONTEST in Madrid, Spain later this year. 

The judges hold the power to change the lives of our young hopefuls forever - among the judges are broadcaster Niamh Ní Chróinín, musician, artist and performer Tadhg Griffin winner of the Radical Spirit Award at Dublin Fringe Festival in 2023. 

Plus, each week we will be joined by a former legend of Eurovision including 2022's Brooke Scullion, 1993 winner Niamh Kavanagh and queen of the Eurovision Linda Martin!

Over six weeks, we follow the journey of our ten hopefuls until just one singer remains - the brand new Irish entry for the Junior Eurovision Song Conest. 

The journey begins on JUNIOR EUROVISION, Sunday 15th  September at 8:30pm on TG4!

name: RTÉ Celebrates Culture Night
summary: Join us for ‘RTÉ Celebrates Culture Night' – a music and arts extravaganza hosted by Denise Chaila and featuring the RTÉ Concert Orchestra with special guests, culminating in an exciting mix of cutting-edge arts and traditional performance with a contemporary twist. The programme will also feature live performances from Villagers, Joe Chester and Gemma Hayes. A highlight will be a pre-recorded performance of David Gray and Colm Mac an Iomaire on Sceilg Mhichíl.

name: Moonflower Murders
summary:
Susan has left publishing and is living in Crete with her long-time boyfriend, Andreas. But her idyll is disturbed by the shadow of a murder committed at a British country hotel eight years ago. Alan Conway visited the hotel and wrote a novel based on what happened there. Cecily Treherne, the young woman who helps run the hotel, read the book and believed the wrong man had been arrested. Now she has disappeared.

Can Susan uncover the secret hidden in the book and find Cecily before it is too late?

name: Racing: Irish Champions Festival
summary: Coverage of the competition.

previousepisode.name: Racing From The Curragh: Irish Champions Festival

name: RTÉ News with ISL
summary: The latest national and international headlines with Irish Sign Language (ISL).

name: Will Sliney's Storytellers
summary: Will Sliney needs your help creating epic new animated superheroes to save the universe from evil forces. Help Will save the world in this drawing show with a difference.

name: Food Matters
summary: A six-part documentary series exploring food sustainability in Ireland. The food system is a major contributor to the climate emergency but the choices we make each day about food can be some of the most useful pieces of climate action we can take personally.

name: Saturday with Colm O'Mongáin
summary: Colm and guests discuss the issues of the week.

name: This Week
summary: Catch up on the events making the news in the past week.

name: Morning Ireland
summary: Morning news programme.

name: Today with Claire Byrne
summary: News stories of the day, analysis and features.

name: Antonia
summary: Antonia breaks up with her partner, has a fallout with her best friend, and loses her job, all on her birthday. Plus, she discovers she has endometriosis. She decides to undergo therapy, but she only attends the first free sessions. As she strives to get her present life in check, Antonia's exhilarating therapy sessions give us a peek into her past and what it means to be a modern woman.

name: The Late Debate
summary: Live debate with the news and political stories of the day.  Presented by Colm Ó Mongáin.

name: Borderline
summary: Forced to collaborate on a serious crime, contrasting detectives Philip Boyd and Aoife Regan, with clashing personalities and backgrounds, overcome initial friction to form an unlikely but formidable crime-fighting partnership.

name: Has Fallen
summary: When a terrorist group led by the villainous Jacob Pearce attacks a high-profile event, with the French Minister of Defence as their target, protection officer Vincent Taleb finds himself working with street-smart MI6 operative Zara Taylor to save the day. But when events take a dark turn, Vincent and Zara soon realize that the plan extends beyond just one politician. When they suspect that one of their colleagues in the security services is feeding information to Jacob, Vincent and Zara find themselves needing to rely only on each other. Increasingly isolated and with Jacob always one step ahead, can this unlikely pair stop Paris from falling to a man hell-bent on vengeance?

name: Ailleurs qu'icitte
summary: Two strangers meet by chance on the side of the road: Oli wants to go to Rouyn-Noranda, Camille wants to go - anywhere but here. Driven by mysterious signs from the universe, they agree to share the road together.

name: VICE News Presents
summary: Eight Tubi Original documentaries speaking to the hottest topics of today.

name: Fragile
summary: Fragile captures the realistic concerns and daily lives of "fragile" teenagers without any hesitation. Shows the taboos that adolescents face during their final teenage years before becoming adults, such as dangerous love with a friend of the opposite sex and risky deviations that they enjoy while avoiding the eyes of adults.

name: NM i gjemsel
summary: Find or get lost! There will be nerve-wracking exercises and tricky challenges in the world's first Norwegian hide and seek championship.

name: Namibias Naturwunder
summary:
Namibia is a country of contrasts, from the arid savannahs to flowing rivers and rugged coastlines. This documentary explores the natural wonders of the country in southern Africa.

Despite the dry and barren habitat, the Kalahari Desert in the east is home to a range of rare and fascinating creatures. The ground pangolin resembles a cute dinosaur but is endangered due to habitat loss and illegal trafficking. Animals must be resourceful and clever to survive in the world's oldest desert and one of the driest places on Earth, the Namib. Around 150 elephants still roam the desert, covering long distances in search of water. The only certainty here is change, as the wind constantly reshapes the dunes. 

On the coast of Namibia, in contrast, the Atlantic crashes onto rugged cliffs and vast beaches while fur seals try to escape their most dangerous predator – the brown hyena.

name: Petrichor
officialSite: https://www.iq.com/album/หยดฝนกลิ่นสนิม-2024-ar002mup45?lang=th_th
summary: The first field deployment of Lieutenant Tul, a rookie officer assigned to the Criminal Investigation Department, unexpectedly brings her face-to-face with Dr. Cherran, a physician from the Institute of Forensic Sciences. Their differing work attitudes create a considerable gap between them, making it challenging to find common ground. Amidst the crime scenes reflecting societal issues, Detective Tul also contends with pressures from a working system favouring influential groups. She navigates the interference aimed at protecting allies and the societal currents that could influence the case's outcome. At least Tul's integrity remains intact amidst these challenges. When she teams up with forensic doctor Cherran, they methodically analyze the evidence left at crime scenes, leading them closer to identifying the perpetrators in each case. With time, both Tul and Cherran grow to trust each other more, working tirelessly to protect the lives of the innocent and ultimately deliver justice to the families of the victims.

name: We Never Stop
summary: The program brings together 100 Chinese physical fitness experts to compete in an undifferentiated physical fitness competition, and ultimately determines a champion to become the "strongest body" of the year.

name: Negative Positive Angler
summary: Tsunehiro's life isn't easy. After a doctor gives him two years to live and debt collectors come knocking, he falls from a bridge. In the knick of time, Hana and her crew spot Tsunehiro and pull him to safety. Before returning, they anchor offshore to fish and Tsunehiro catches a huge sea bass in a bout of beginner's luck. As his apartment building crumbles, Tsunehiro's new life begins to unfold!

name: Tian Ying
summary: Lu Chen, the "Shadow" undercover agent of Fuyun Division, was cursed by black fire for destroying the demon sect's divine spell, and his cultivation was completely destroyed. After ten years of living in exile and seclusion, Master Tian Lan appeared again and gave Lu Chen the task of going to the Kunlun Sect to find the undercover demon sect. In order to repair the damaged Five Elements God Disk, Lu Chen was ordered to become a hundred of the Kunlun Sect. A handyman disciple in the thatched cottage. In the process of carrying out the mission, he met many friends and the love of his life Yi Xin, and gradually felt the warmth of the world. At the same time, he touched on the secrets behind Kunlun from various clues, and discovered that the black dragon sealed in the Kunlun Forbidden Land was not an evil monster, but had always claimed to be for The righteous Tian Lan actually had other plans. After realizing the facts, Lu Chen was confused for a while. With Yi Xin's encouragement, he decided to face the past and no longer stick to the so-called distinction between good and evil, but to follow his heart and do the right thing.

name: National Parks from Above
summary: Across the world, countries have turned some of their most incredible areas of natural beauty into National Parks, preserving them for generations to come. From the frozen expanse of Iceland's Vatnajökull ice cap to the steep limestone gorges of the Cévennes in southern France, this series will explore these areas by not only taking a cinematic journey from above, but also by swooping down closer to the ground to meet the people who use these landscapes every day, discovering the oftenextreme jobs they undertake and the unique lives they lead.

name: Eating Inn
summary: An exploration of Asia's top five-star venues, offering a guide to the very best around the region and uncovering the secrets behind the signature dishes of chefs.

previousepisode.name: Ritz Carlton Millenia, Singapore Pt 2 Summer Pavillion

name: Behind Behani
summary:
In an eight-part series, recording artist Rebekah "Behani" Behbahani shares the highs and lows of pursuing music stardom on a global stage, while learning to balance motherhood, her love-life, and everything in-between. 

 Having already caught the attention of chart-topping musicians and producers abroad, collaborating with GRAMMY® Award-winning artists DJ Khaled and Ne-Yo, Behani's profile continues to rise.

 In true popstar fashion, Behani along with her fiancé, prominent investor and philanthropist Alex Waislitz (OAM), and their daughter Storm jet between Melbourne and the United States in pursuit of Behani's relentless ambition to succeed as an artist and businesswoman managing her music career.

 Already making her mark in Australia, Behani has released five singles which have amassed over 10 million streams. Her debut single Real Man featuring R&B star Ne-Yo catapulted into the pop stratosphere and was soon followed by Medicine, Pretty Beast, Again & Again, Do It and Comfortable featuring Tyga. Behani will be opening for Ne-Yo on his upcoming arena tour across Australia and New Zealand, performing for some of the biggest audiences of her career.

name: Kalahari: Land of the Secret Alliances
summary: Wander the vast, inhospitable lowlands of Africa's Kalahari Basin, where an extraordinarily diverse array of animals, from massive elephants to tiny weaver birds, work together to find resources, protect their young, and survive the harsh conditions.

name: Isa TKM
summary: The party is about to begin – Isa's true love is only a playlist away. This fun story about teens and tweens combines comedy, music and romance in a plot that centers on Isabella, known as "Isa," a charismatic girl who faces her first love, first kiss, and all of the other teen firsts. ISA TKM (TKM is short for "Te Quiero Mucho" in a text message) chronicles the adventures, trials and tribulations, successes, and failures of its adolescent protagonists with bold and irreverent humor, warmth and wisdom.

previousepisode.name: Colorín colorado, la fiesta ha terminado.

name: Sueña conmigo
summary:
The auditions for the reality show Soy tu Súper Star have already begun. And everyone wants to participate! Because the winning boy or girl will achieve the fame and success of a musical superstar. And obviously, Clara Molina does not plan to be left behind in the competition.

This is the opportunity she has waited for her whole life. The only problem is that her parents do not allow her to sign up. So Clara will have to create Roxy Pop, her secret identity, to attend the reality show's practices and galas.

Luca is the complete opposite of Clara. He does not like glamour or TV shows. But he could spend hours playing the guitar in the solitude of his room. Or rehearsing a song with his friends. Luca cannot stand Clara. But very soon, and despite everything, Luca's heart will start beating for Roxy Pop.

He dreams of being a musical star. Of finding his soulmate. Of having the most original mascot at school or a rock band in the garage of his house. Dream of achieving everything, and in the meantime, Sueña Conmigo.

name: Isa tk+
summary: Isa, now a pop idol, is sent by her record label to study at a renowned performing arts school. Alex, her best friend Linda, and the inimitable Rey follow her. But living in a new city brings many changes. She signs a contract with a new record label, is separated from Alex and her band, is consumed with trying to help her friend Linda keep her scholarship, and even helps save the school from shutting down. In the midst of all these changes and adventures, the always happy and radiant Isa, will need to choose between her friends and her growing fame.

previousepisode.name: Sigue a tu corazón y llegas a la graduación

name: Four Go Flatting
summary: Four young men living with intellectual disabilities move out of home to live independently. In a flat with no parents and no rules, there is fun, games, and an avalanche of challenges ahead! Made with the support of NZ on Air.

name: MS NOW Special Coverage
summary: Special coverage of news events on MS NOW.

nextepisode.name: MS NOW Live: Together in Texas

name: The Scold's Bridle
summary: Adaptation of Minette Walters crime novel. A woman is found dead in her bath with her wrists slashed and a medieval scold's bridle around her head. What happened before her death?

name: Axel terug naar Amerika
summary: Axel Daeseleire explores America from Texas to New York, with humor and a keen eye for extremes.

name: The Hunt for the Chameleon Killer
summary: Series revealing the twelve-year worldwide hunt for 'The Chameleon Killer' Elaine Parent, who was once the most-wanted woman in the world.

name: Stranded on Honeymoon Island
summary:
Stranded on Honeymoon Island is no ordinary relationship show, it will fast track it all. Twelve unlucky-in-love singles will be matched into couples and then stranded on a deserted island. Isolated and pitted against the forces of nature, will true love blossom and survive…or dive?

In this bold and original new adventure dating format, six couples are matched by experts and then immediately after committing themselves to each other in an intimate ceremony, will be dramatically abandoned in idyllic isolation for the adventure of a lifetime.

On these remote beaches, fledgling relationships are soon put to the test as the couples live together and fend for themselves with few resources. Marooned and alone, they must communicate and collaborate to get by, with nowhere to run when the going gets tough. Will an escape from modern life bring them closer together or push them apart? Will it lead to love or loathing?

name: Gestrand op Honeymoon Island
summary: Five couples have been selected to embark on the ultimate love adventure: getting married and then immediately being dropped off on a deserted island. "Can love succeed if you have nothing but each other?" That is the question in the new Videoland Original Gestrand op Honeymoon Island.

name: Gestrandet... in den Flitterwochen
summary: Love test in paradise: In Gestrandet... in den Flitterwochen twelve singles dare to make a very special start to a new life: They say "I do" to a stranger and spend their honeymoon on a deserted island - with no distractions, no external influences. A curse or a blessing for young love?

previousepisode.name: Das große Finale: Wer verlässt die Flitterwochen-Insel als Paar?

name: Stranded on Honeymoon Island
summary: In this bold and original new adventure dating format, four couples are matched by experts. Immediately after committing themselves to each other in an intimate ceremony, they are dramatically abandoned on their own deserted tropical islands for the adventure of a lifetime.

name: Casados no Paraíso
summary: This new adventure combines the best ingredients of the relationship format with the best of the survival formats on exotic islands.

name: Joseph Wambaugh's The Blue Knight
summary:
The Blue Knight is a 1973 television miniseries and theatrical film adapted from Joseph Wambaugh's 1973 novel The Blue Knight. It inspired the 1975 TV series also titled The Blue Knight. The miniseries was broadcast on NBC TV in November 1973, consisted of four one-hour episodes (including commercials), was directed by Robert Butler, and featured an all star cast headed by William Holden as Police Officer Bumper Morgan.

Bumper Morgan is a 20-year veteran of the Los Angeles Police Department who is scheduled to retire in a week. Before he leaves, he must work on the murder of a prostitute in one of LA's far corners. Along the way, he must grapple with vicious thugs, his fellow officers who have mixed feelings about his retirement, and his woman who wants him to leave the streets.

name: Tan Suo Xin Jing
summary: Step into the wild with Chinese actor and singer Wang Yibo in "Exploring the Unknown with Wang Yibo," a thrilling new documentary series from Discovery. Get ready to conquer rugged terrains, face intense challenges, and uncover nature's beauty like never before.

name: Bizi Birleştiren Hayat
summary: Münevver Hanım, who comes from a noble family, lives with her veteran maid Suzan in her mansion, which is still ostentatious despite its age. One night, a little girl left at the door of the mansion by her older sister will completely change not only Münevver's life but also the lives of many others. Little Mine is Münevver's granddaughter, whose existence Münevver is unaware of. Mrs. Münevver is surprised to see the necklace around Mine's neck and goes in search of her daughter, who has not called her for years. There are so many secrets and such a murder that when these are revealed, the lives of many people, including Münevver, will be turned upside down, orders will be disrupted, homes will fall apart, and nothing will ever be the same again.

name: La Revuelta
summary:
Un grupo de grandes cómicos y cómicas acompañan a David Broncano, que entrevista a gente famosa en un teatro del centro de Madrid para que al final el protagonista sea uno del público que se sentó en la tercera fila.

Artistas, deportistas, científicos y todo tipo de personalidades se sumergen en las conversaciones más impredecibles con el presentador, siempre acompañado por su banda: Ricardo Castella, veterano de la comedia española, y el campeón de beatbox Grison, una mina antipersona de chistes que nunca sabes cuándo ni cómo va a saltar. Además, Jorge Ponce, el cómico residente, llevará el humor cada vez más lejos aunque el cable de la cámara solo le permita llegar a Gran Vía.

A ellos se suman colaboradoras y colaboradores de primera división (Lala Chus, Valeria Ros, Yunez Chaib, Pablo Ibarburu, Pantomima Full, Ernesto Sevilla…), así como amigos del programa como Antonio Resines o Dani Rovira en un programa espontáneo donde nunca sabes qué va a pasar… salvo que te vas a reír

name: Classic Artist
summary: A series looking at progressive rock groups of the 1960's and 70's.

name: La última noche en Tremor
summary: A musician and composer in crisis retreats into a coastal village in the north to finish his latest work. His only neighbors for miles around are a married couple living in the next house. After a serious accident during a storm, the musician begins to experience some terrifying visions about his neighbors.

name: I'm a Noble on the Brink of Ruin, So I Might as Well Try Mastering Magic
summary: This middle-aged commoner now finds himself in the body of Liam Hamilton, the young son of a noble house teetering on the brink of collapse. Between his fervidly desperate father and his utterly apathetic brothers, the only bright side to his new situation is that Liam can finally try learning magic like he's always wanted. Little does he know his hobby of choice may be about to turn his life upside-down yet again! Will Liam be able to master the craft of magic? And will it be enough to save him from the shadow looming over his family...?

name: Doppelgänger. Sobowtór
summary: Inspired by true events, this is the story of a special service agent who steals another man's identity. Posing as someone he is not, he builds a successful undercover career.

name: Siyah Kalp
summary: Действие фильма происходит в Каппадокии. Близнецы Мелек и Ной, мальчик и девочка, родились при драматических обстоятельствах.

name: The Maternity Matron in the Cold Palace
summary: Zhang Xiaoxue, a modern nanny, crashes into the past and finds herself in the Cold Palace! She puts her skills to work by transforming the fate of a forgotten consort. This is the beginning of her spectacular journey of making a mark in the ancient world!

name: Mystic Nine
summary: Mystic Nine follows Zhang Qishan (William Chan) as he joins forces with Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng), alongside Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Mystic Nine, when turmoil returns to Changsha. The mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a century-old secret. Faced with life-and-death choices, bound by brotherhood, responsibility to their sects, and devotion to their country, they risk everything to protect their home and overcome the crisis

name: A Talented Girl Grows Up
summary: Cheng Manyi, unhappy with her real life, faints after an act of bravery and dreams of becoming the heroine of "The World's Top Talent," where she meets Wen Chenyu, the Greatest Scholar. Pretending to be talented, she enters a contract marriage with him, leading to humorous misunderstandings and evolving trust. As she aims to become a top inspector of the Great Feng dynasty, Cheng Manyi faces challenges and adversaries with the help of her friends.

name: Killer Safari
summary: The best safari sightings, all in one place. It's as close as you'll get without being there. Epic encounters, amazing behaviour and fascinating info from expert guides make this the ride of your life. The highest rated wildlife encounters are wrapped up in one game-drive. Keep your eyes peeled – in the African bush the most unexpected sighting is always just around the corner!

name: Jeongnyeon: The Star is Born
summary: Jeong Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich?

name: Los Chávez
summary: Six-time world champion boxer Julio César Chávez reluctantly opens up about his private life and his family. His daughter, Nicole, tries to reunite them through a game, challenging everybody to confront their insecurities. The series features touching and funny moments and depicts a father's struggle to save his children from addiction. A beautiful beachfront celebration highlights a new beginning for the Chávez family.
